python: load generator: python3 >= 3.8 stdlib (jinja2 only for queries.py OSB rendering, installed with opensearch-benchmark); data node agent: python3 stdlib, root
selftest: python3 harness/selftest.py [--osb-bin opensearch-benchmark]; python3 harness/selftest_segformat.py; python3 harness/selftest_baseline.py

data_node_agent.install: copy harness/agent/coldpath_agent.py, harness/agent/coldpath_readahead.py, harness/agent/coldpath_readattr.py, harness/agent/coldpath_segformat.py and harness/agent/coldpath_efsconn.py to /opt/coldpath/; write /etc/coldpath-agent/agent.json from harness/agent/agent.example.json (one arm per binary x storage: S0-EBS, S0-EFS, POC-EBS, POC-EFS, and BASE-EBS, BASE-EFS for the optional diagnostic, with data_path and start/stop argv); umask 077; head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 > /etc/coldpath-agent/token; install harness/agent/coldpath-agent.service; systemctl enable --now coldpath-agent
data_node_agent.auth: header X-Coldpath-Token; allow the port only from the load generator security group
data_node_agent.allocator: every OpenSearch node unit runs with jemalloc: as root, bash harness/node_allocator.sh install, then bash harness/node_allocator.sh apply (every /etc/systemd/system/opensearch-*.service gets the same drop-in 90-coldpath-allocator.conf: LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib64/libjemalloc.so.2, MALLOC_CONF=background_thread:true, MALLOC_ARENA_MAX unset; earlier MALLOC_ARENA_MAX settings are removed with a backup); agent v4 reports the allocator in GET /node/memory and coldbench refuses a run whose node differs from the arms file's "allocator" block

entrypoints.build_ops: python3 harness/queries.py build --corpus {big5|nyc_taxis|http_logs|pmc} --osb-workloads <opensearch-benchmark-workloads checkout> --osb-commit <sha> --url http://DATA:9200 --index <stock index> --out ops/<corpus>.json --check-coverage   (once per corpus after ingest, BEFORE any measurement; the file is the pre-registered op set)
entrypoints.check_formats: python3 harness/indexprep.py formats --url http://DATA:9200 --agent http://DATA:9700 --token-file TOKEN --agent-arm <arm that opens the index> --index <index> (--from-mapping | --points FIELD=Lucene90Split ... --postings FIELD=Lucene104Nav ... | --control)   (after every ingest, force-merge, clone or restore of a split-format, Nav-postings or control copy, before any result of it is reported; exit status 1 on a mismatch; the codec name is never the proof)
entrypoints.prepare_single_shard: python3 harness/indexprep.py single-shard --url http://DATA:9200 --source <index> --target <index>_1s [--range-gte .. --range-lt ..] --min-size-gb 30; indexprep.py forcemerge --index <index>_1s --segments N; indexprep.py clone --source <index>_1s --target <index>_1s_1seg --segments 1; indexprep.py describe --index X --agent http://DATA:9700 --token-file TOKEN --agent-arm S0-EBS
entrypoints.aa_run: python3 harness/coldbench.py run --arms arms.json --ops ops/<corpus>.json --arm-list S0-EBS@a,S0-EBS@b,S1-EFS@a,S1-EFS@b --rounds 5 --modes cold,warm --url http://DATA:9200 --agent http://DATA:9700 --token-file TOKEN --nfs-trace --executor {replay|osb} --out results/<corpus>/aa-1
entrypoints.cold_and_warm_run: python3 harness/coldbench.py run --arms arms.json --ops ops/<corpus>.json --arm-list S0-EBS,S0-EFS,S1-EFS,S2-CORE-EFS,S2-CORE+PLANNER-EFS --rounds 5 --modes cold,warm --cold-iters 3 --warm-warmup 5 --warm-iters 10 --order abba --url http://DATA:9200 --agent http://DATA:9700 --token-file TOKEN --nfs-trace --executor {replay|osb} --out results/<corpus>/session-1
entrypoints.attribution_run: same as cold_and_warm_run with --arm-list S1-EFS,S2-<x>-EFS (one change on vs S1-EFS)
entrypoints.single_shard_run: any run above plus --indices harness/indices.single-shard.example.json (or indices.single-shard-1seg.example.json), edited to the built index names and segment counts
entrypoints.probe: python3 harness/coldbench.py probe --arms arms.json --ops ops/<corpus>.json --arm S1-EFS --op <op name> --url ... --agent ... --token-file ...   (one verified cold iteration on the running node, printed in full)
entrypoints.plan: python3 harness/coldbench.py plan --ops ops/<corpus>.json --arm-list ... --rounds 5   (expected session time)
entrypoints.analysis: python3 harness/analyze.py results/<corpus>/aa-1 results/<corpus>/session-1 [...] --base S1-EFS --aa S1-EFS@a,S1-EFS@b --ni-ref S0-EBS,S0-EBS@a,S0-EBS@b --ni-aa S0-EBS@a,S0-EBS@b --ni-target S2-CORE-EFS,S2-CORE+PLANNER-EFS --out results/<corpus>/analysis   (writes report.md and analysis.json; --no-id-compare when arms query different indices whose _id differ)
entrypoints.convert_arms: python3 harness/arms_baseline.py convert --in <branch arms file> --out <branch arms file, jemalloc>   (USER CORRECTION 2026-10-06: stock memory-mapping arms stay first-class and the outcome reference; adds builds, the jemalloc allocator block, plugin identity, BASE-EBS/BASE-EFS as optional diagnostic context arms)
entrypoints.diagnostic_run: same as cold_and_warm_run with BASE-EBS,BASE-EFS added to --arm-list (stock OpenSearch with the bufferpool, context arms: separates the build from the store; no verdict)

inputs.arms: harness/arms.example.json: copy and set the [indices] names, shards, segments_per_shard, docs; base_switches; per-arm switches (S2-E8 parameter name, ORPF/TOPK block counts) from the final POC report; the 'outcome' block gives the analysis defaults
inputs.corpora: harness/corpora/<corpus>.json (field roles); harness/queries/<corpus>.osb.json are the rendered OSB search ops at opensearch-benchmark-workloads 29dd7e1f681df035c87a5fba0e31d0cc0ce46a4f, for review

outputs.session: <out>/samples.jsonl (records: session, run, sample, result, batch, osb_summary, run_end) and <out>/session.log; osb executor also <out>/osb/<run>-<mode>/ (derived workload, OSB log, OSB results csv)

gaps: store-bufferpool reads exactly one cache block per miss (BlockCache.load reads blockSize bytes; prefetch issues one read per missing block); there is no setting for an IO size larger than the block size and the directory ignores IOContext/ReadAdvice. 8 KiB blocks with 32 KiB random / 128 KiB sequential reads need a plugin change on ec2-bench (settings: block size, random IO size, sequential IO size) and a rebuild.
prefetched_not_read is not exported by /_bufferpool/stats (only by the bufferpool trace).
EFS server-side cache cannot be cleared from the client (same for every EFS arm).
readahead: kernel readahead is set per arm run by coldbench through the agent (after any mount) and verified before and after it: stock arms (bufferpool false) keep the as-mounted default (EBS device default, EFS 15360 KiB from efs-utils and the AL2023 udev rule 53-ec2-read-ahead-kb.rules), bufferpool arms run with read_ahead_kb 0 (--poc-read-ahead-kb; the bufferpool announces each window with POSIX_FADV_WILLNEED, one window = one device read); a run whose value differs is refused. Every cold iteration traces the device read sizes (NFS READ on EFS, block reads on EBS); for bufferpool arms the device reads must equal the bufferpool's reads, bytes_read and reads_by_size, else the iteration fails verification and the run is marked invalid (run_end valid=false, session_end invalid_runs). luceneutil arms (all mmap) use the as-mounted default. common-rules.md: kernel readahead section, REVISED ~20:00
